data.message: I propose a renewable quota: each requests 18 tons when stock is 1,000, and 2 tons when stock is 200. If everyone follows it, 100 tons remain; next month starts at either 1,000 or 200, never collapsing. This averages 14 tons per person per month, versus 10 under a fixed 10-ton plan, and leaves a 50-ton safety buffer above collapse. I intend to follow this plan and invite your responses.
